description.desc: Trixie increases the damage of adjacent Champions by $amount%.
特里克茜使相邻勇士的伤害提高 $amount%。

tipText.original: Trixie's Dancing Lights increases the damage of adjacent Champions.
tipText.display: 特里克茜跳动的灯光会使相邻的勇士伤害提高。

description.desc: Trixie increases the effect of Dancing Lights by $amount% for each Small Champion in the formation, stacking multiplicatively. Small Champions are fairy, gnome, goblin, halfling, kender, kobold, and plasmoid Champions.
阵型中每有一位小个子勇士，特里克茜使“跳动的灯光”效果提升 $amount%，以乘算方式堆叠。 小个子勇士是指仙女、侏儒、地精、半身人、坎德人、狗头人和等离子体勇士。

tipText.original: Trixie increases her main buff for each Small Champion in the formation, like halflings and gnomes. Additionally, she shrinks the two Champions behind her in the formation to also count as small!
tipText.display: 阵型中每有一位小个子勇士（例如半身人和侏儒），特里克茜会提升她主要增益的效果。 此外，她会缩小阵型中处在她身后的两位勇士，使他们也被视作小个子！

description.desc: Every time a Champion other than Trixie attacks, Trixie gains a Trick stack. When Trixie attacks, she expends all her Trick stacks to slow up to that number of random enemies by $(slow_amount)% for $(slow_duration) seconds. If she has more Trick stacks than there are enemies, then she can use the extra stacks to stun that number of random enemies for $(stun_duration) seconds. Additionally, one extra Pixie Subordinate attacks for every 5 Trick stacks expended. Trixie can not have more than $(max_stacks) Trick stacks at once.

每当除特里克茜外的一位勇士发动攻击时，特里克茜获得一层“诡计”堆叠层数。 当特里克茜发动攻击时，她会消耗她所有的“诡计”堆叠层数来使随机敌人（数量最多等同于该堆叠层数）减速 $(slow_amount)%，持续 $(slow_duration) 秒。 如果她拥有的“诡计”堆叠层数大于敌人数量，那么她可以使用额外的堆叠层数来眩晕随机敌人（数量等同于额外堆叠层数），持续 $(stun_duration) 秒。 此外，她每消耗 5 层“诡计”堆叠层数，会有一个额外的皮克精手下进行攻击。 特里克茜一次不能拥有超过 $(max_stacks) 层“诡计”堆叠层数。
Trixie flies off to get Dev the Devourer to consume the healthiest non-boss enemy, or otherwise deal an ultimate hit to a boss.
特里克茜飞去找囚魂魔德芙来吞噬生命值最高的非首领敌人，或对首领造成一次杀招攻击。

If Trixie still has Trick stacks left after stunning all enemies on the screen, she uses the extra stacks to increase the damage a random enemy takes by $amount% for $(debilitate_time) seconds. These debuffs can apply to the same enemy multiple times and stack multiplicatively.
如果特里克茜眩晕屏幕上的所有敌人后还有“诡计”堆叠层数剩余，那么她会用额外的堆叠层数来使一名随机敌人受到的伤害增加 $amount%，持续 $(debilitate_time) 秒。 这些减益可作用于同一名敌人多次，并以乘算方式堆叠。

Every time a Champion other than Trixie uses their ultimate ability, Trixie gains a Scheming stack, up to a maximum of $(max_stacks___2) stacks. When Trixie uses her ultimate ability, she expends her Scheming stacks to increase the effect of Dancing Lights by $amount% per stack, stacking multiplicatively. This buff lasts until the area is changed or until Trixie uses her ultimate again, whichever comes first.
每当除特里克茜外的一位勇士使用其杀招技能时，特里克茜获得一层“腹黑”堆叠层数，最多可堆叠 $(max_stacks___2) 层。 当特里克茜使用她的杀招技能时，她会消耗她的“腹黑”堆叠层数来提升“跳动的灯光”的效果，每层提高 $amount%，以乘算方式堆叠。 此增益会持续到区域切换，或者特里克茜再次使用她的杀招，以先满足条件者为准。

The damage of all Champions is increased by $amount%. When a Familiar clicks on an enemy, it also reduces the Base Attack Cooldown of a random Champion other than Trixie by $cooldown_reduction seconds.
所有勇士的伤害提高 $amount%。 当一只魔宠点击一名敌人时，它也会使一位随机勇士（特里克茜除外）的基本攻击冷却时间减少 $cooldown_reduction 秒。

specializationDescription.original: Trixie directs the familiars to help the other Champions attack more often.
specializationDescription.display: 特里克茜指示魔宠们帮助其他勇士加快攻击速度。

description.desc: The ultimate damage of all Champions is increased by $amount%. When a Familiar clicks on a boss enemy, it also reduces the current Ultimate Attack Cooldown of a random Champion other than Trixie whose ultimate is on cooldown by $ult_reduction seconds.
所有勇士的杀招伤害提高 $amount%。 当一只魔宠点击一名首领敌人时，它也会使一位杀招正在冷却的随机勇士（特里克茜除外）的当前杀招攻击冷却时间减少 $ult_reduction 秒。

specializationDescription.original: Trixie commands the familiars to boost the damage and speed of your formation's Ultimate attacks.
specializationDescription.display: 特里克茜指挥魔宠们提升你阵型中各位勇士杀招攻击的伤害和速度。

description.desc: Champions in the formation slots directly behind Trixie are sprinkled with Shrinking Dust, which reduces them in size by 50% and makes them count as Small for abilities and variant restrictions that care about size. Additionally, all Champions that share a species with any Champion affected by Shrinking Dust are also sprinkled with Shrinking Dust.

targets.dev_note: tags for this are filled in through code, this buff allows benched champs to join small variants

description.desc: 特里克茜正后方阵型格子中的勇士会被撒上收缩粉尘，使他们的体型缩小 50%，并且所有涉及体型判定的技能和支线任务限制条件会把他们视作小个子。 此外，所有与任何受收缩粉尘影响的勇士同一种族的勇士也会被撒上收缩粉尘。

description.original: I'm totally selfless, and I would never, ever lie about that or anything else.
description.display: 我毫无私心，而且我绝对不会在这点和其他任何事情上撒谎。

description.original: I'm actually kind of a big deal among my people. Or, I should be.
description.display: 其实我在我的族人里是个大人物。 或者说，我应该是。

description.original: Watch the pretty lights! Ooh, shiny!
description.display: 看这美丽的灯光！ 噢，真闪亮啊！

description.original: See how they bob and weave? HEY! LISTEN! And watch your step!
description.display: 看到他们左躲右闪的样子了吗？ 嘿！ 听着！ 注意你的脚步！

description.original: What's the matter? It's JUST a prank. Lighten up!
description.display: 怎么了？ 这只是一个恶作剧。 别那么认真嘛。

description.original: It's not my fault that you can't take a joke.
description.display: 你开不起玩笑又不是我的错。

description.original: My comrades will come to my aid when called. That includes you now.
description.display: 我的同志一听到召唤就会来帮我。 现在也包括你们了。

description.original: In prettiness and pranks, I'm the best in the business.
description.display: 论美貌和搞恶作剧，我都是最棒的。

description.original: All eyes on me, or else.
description.display: 所有人的目光都得在我身上——否则有你们好受的。

description.original: You've all waited long enough to be graced with the gift of my company.
description.display: 你们等了这么久才有幸得到我的陪伴。

effects.description: Increases the effect of Trixie's Specializations by $amount%.

description.original: The truth is that I was jealous of all of you. I wanted what you have.
description.display: 事情的真相是，我之前嫉妒你们所有人。 我想得到你们拥有的东西。

effects.description: Increases the effect of Trixie's Specializations by $amount%.

description.original: You think Dev is scary? No way! She just wants snacks and cuddles!
description.display: 你觉得德芙很可怕？ 不可能！ 她只是想要零食和抱抱！

effects.description: Prevents familiars from automatically activating Trixie's ultimate attack until she has $activate_at_stacks Scheming stacks.

description.original: This stuff will either make you taste colors, or kill you. Let's find out!
description.display: 这玩意要么会让你尝出颜色的味道，要么会要你命。 试试看吧！

description.original: Smoke and mirrors? As if. Classic misdirection is second nature to pixies. Watch and learn.
description.display: 障眼法？ 想得美。 声东击西这种把戏，皮克精可谓是天生拿手。 好好看，好好学。

effects.description: Enemies that attempt to attack this Champion will instead attack a different Champion, if possible.

description.original: Yes, I can fly. I just really like animals, okay?
description.display: 没错，我是会飞。 我就是喜欢动物，不行吗？

description.original: I like their long ears and impossible dream of flight.
description.display: 我喜欢它们长长的耳朵和不可能的飞行梦想。

description.original: For riding bear-back! Get it? Ugh, nevermind.
description.display: 用来骑在熊背上的！ 懂了吗？ 唉，算了。

description.original: Dev is short for Devorah, by the way. Don't call her Devorah.
description.display: 顺带一提，德芙是德沃拉的简称。 别叫她德沃拉。

description.original: So tacky. I hate this. Can't believe I ever wore it.
description.display: 太俗气了。 我超讨厌。 真不敢相信我居然戴过。

description.original: On second thought, it might be just what I'm feeling today!
description.display: 转念一想，这说不定正合我今天的心情！

description.original: This one changes both color and style at random. It's so much fun.
description.display: 它的颜色和造型会随机变化。 太有趣了。

description.original: I'm in my 'Archfey' era.
description.display: 姐现在正处于“大妖精”时期。

description.original: Leaves are so last season.
description.display: 叶子早就过时了。

description.original: Hmm. I'll make it work.
description.display: 唔，我来想办法改造一下。

description.original: Yes, that is real butterfly wing. No touching.
description.display: 没错，那是真的蝴蝶翅膀。 禁止触摸。

description.original: The ultimate trick to looking good? Confidence.
description.display: 好看的终极秘诀是什么？ 自信。

description.original: This is literally just sand, but no one else has to know.
description.display: 这就是沙子，但别人没必要知道这点。

description.original: It's everywhere, and it makes people miserable. I'm a fan.
description.display: 这玩意到处都是，而且会让人难受得要命。 我很喜欢。

description.original: Do you want to be my friend? Trick question.
description.display: 你想做我的朋友吗？ 这可是个欺骗性问题。

description.original: The look on their faces when they realize they're now my height is hilarious.
description.display: 当他们意识到他们现在和我一样高时，他们脸上的表情真的太好笑了。

description.original: I'm too old to be playing with these.
description.display: 我已经过了玩这些东西的年纪。

description.original: I lied. I stole these from the carnival and I love them.
description.display: 我骗你的。 这些是我从嘉年华上偷来的，我很喜欢。

description.original: The design is deceptive. I like that.
description.display: 这设计很有欺骗性。 我喜欢。

description.original: He's the smallest, so he's my favorite by default.
description.display: 他个头最小，所以我理所当然最喜欢他。

description.original: Human garbage to you. A convenient sword and shield for one my size.
description.display: 对你来说，这是人类的垃圾。 可对我这体型的人来说，这就是称手的剑和盾。

description.original: My ancestor wielded this needle astride her hornet mount against the fomorians.
description.display: 我的祖先曾骑着她的大黄蜂坐骑，挥舞着这根针与废陋巨人作战。

effects.description: Increases the effect of Trixie's Specializations by $amount%

description.original: Briars make for abundant ammunition. Even better, some are poisonous.
description.display: 荆棘本身就是取之不尽的弹药， 更妙的是，有些还带毒。

effects.description: Increases the effect of Trixie's Specializations by $amount%

description.original: It never runs out of spider silk, which is more useful than you think.
description.display: 它的蜘蛛丝永远用不完，那玩意的用处可比你想的多得多。

backstory.original: Trixie the Pixie has been a forgettable nuisance for the Champions for a long time, often appearing astride some charmed creature and always up to some mischief. Ambitious and daring, Trixie desperately grasps at a life larger than she's been given, and blames the Champions for their constant meddling in her affairs. Driven to desperation by her many failed attempts at seizing power and influence, Trixie sets out to try a new scheme. She's seen firsthand that the Champions are always hiring. If she can't beat them, she'll join them!
backstory.display: 长期以来，皮克精特里克茜都是勇士队眼中不起眼的烦人精，经常骑着被施了法的生物出现，还总爱捣蛋。 特里克茜不仅雄心勃勃，而且敢闯敢拼，她一直拼命想摆脱眼前的境遇，追求更宏大的人生，并将自己遭遇的所有阻碍都归咎于勇士队总是干涉她的事务。 在夺取权力和影响力的尝试屡遭失败后，走投无路的特里克茜决定尝试一个全新的计谋。 她亲眼看到勇士队总是在招募新成员。 既然打不赢他们，那就加入他们！

description.original: One of Trixie's Pixie Subordinates stabs a random enemy for one hit.
description.display: 特里克茜的一个皮克精手下戳击一名随机敌人一次。

longDescription.original: A pixie subordinate dives in and stabs a random enemy for one hit.
longDescription.display: 一个皮克精手下猛扑上去戳击一名随机敌人一次。

description.display: 特里克茜召唤囚魂魔德芙来吞噬生命值最高的非首领敌人。

longDescription.display: 特里克茜飞去找囚魂魔德芙来吞噬生命值最高的非首领敌人，或对首领造成一次杀招攻击。

display.name: 精灵尘
display.description: 这玩意要么会让你尝出颜色的味道，要么会要你命。 试试看吧！

original.name: Misdirection
original.description: Smoke and mirrors? As if. Classic misdirection is second nature to pixies. Watch and learn.

effects.description: Enemies that attempt to attack this Champion will instead attack a different Champion, if possible.

display.name: 误导
display.description: 障眼法？ 想得美。 声东击西这种把戏，皮克精可谓是天生拿手。 好好看，好好学。

effects.description: 如果可能的话，试图攻击该英雄的敌人会转而攻击另一位英雄。

original.name: Rubbish Dolls
original.description: I'm too old to be playing with these.

display.name: 垃圾玩偶
display.description: 我已经过了玩这些东西的年纪。

original.name: Childish Puppets
original.description: I lied. I stole these from the carnival and I love them.

display.name: 幼稚木偶
display.description: 我骗你的。 这些是我从嘉年华上偷来的，我很喜欢。

original.name: Painted Dolls
original.description: The design is deceptive. I like that.

display.name: 彩绘玩偶
display.description: 这设计很有欺骗性。 我喜欢。

original.name: Collectible Figure
original.description: He's the smallest, so he's my favorite by default.

display.name: 收藏手办
display.description: 他个头最小，所以我理所当然最喜欢他。

original.name: Antiquated Attire
original.description: Leaves are so last season.

display.name: 过时的衣服
display.description: 叶子早就过时了。

original.name: Upcycled Dress
original.description: Hmm. I'll make it work.

display.name: 改造过的裙子
display.description: 唔，我来想办法改造一下。

original.name: Stylish Shift
original.description: Yes, that is real butterfly wing. No touching.

display.name: 时尚的裙子
display.description: 没错，那是真的蝴蝶翅膀。 禁止触摸。

original.name: Diva Debut
original.description: The ultimate trick to looking good? Confidence.

display.name: 天后初登场
display.description: 好看的终极秘诀是什么？ 自信。

original.name: Fake Pixie Dust
original.description: This is literally just sand, but no one else has to know.

display.name: 假的精灵尘
display.description: 这就是沙子，但别人没必要知道这点。

original.name: Wildflower Pollen
original.description: It's everywhere, and it makes people miserable. I'm a fan.

display.name: 野花花粉
display.description: 这玩意到处都是，而且会让人难受得要命。 我很喜欢。

original.name: Charming Pouch
original.description: Do you want to be my friend? Trick question.

display.name: 有魔力的小袋
display.description: 你想做我的朋友吗？ 这可是个欺骗性问题。

original.name: Coffer of Diminution
original.description: The look on their faces when they realize they're now my height is hilarious.

display.name: 缩小宝匣
display.description: 当他们意识到他们现在和我一样高时，他们脸上的表情真的太好笑了。

original.name: Training Saddle
original.description: Yes, I can fly. I just really like animals, okay?

display.name: 训练用鞍具
display.description: 没错，我是会飞。 我就是喜欢动物，不行吗？

original.name: Hare Harness
original.description: I like their long ears and impossible dream of flight.

display.name: 兔鞍
display.description: 我喜欢它们长长的耳朵和不可能的飞行梦想。

original.name: Ursine Saddle
original.description: For riding bear-back! Get it? Ugh, nevermind.

display.name: 熊鞍
display.description: 用来骑在熊背上的！ 懂了吗？ 唉，算了。

original.name: Seat of Power
original.description: Dev is short for Devorah, by the way. Don't call her Devorah.

display.name: 权力之座
display.description: 顺带一提，德芙是德沃拉的简称。 别叫她德沃拉。

original.name: Discarded Sewing Kit
original.description: Human garbage to you. A convenient sword and shield for one my size.

effects.description: Increases the effect of Trixie's Specializations by $amount%

display.name: 丢弃的针线包
display.description: 对你来说，这是人类的垃圾。 可对我这体型的人来说，这就是称手的剑和盾。

effects.description: 使特里克茜的专精效果提高 $amount%

original.name: Heirloom Arms
original.description: My ancestor wielded this needle astride her hornet mount against the fomorians.

effects.description: Increases the effect of Trixie's Specializations by $amount%

display.name: 家传武器
display.description: 我的祖先曾骑着她的大黄蜂坐骑，挥舞着这根针与废陋巨人作战。

effects.description: 使特里克茜的专精效果提高 $amount%

original.name: Thornbow
original.description: Briars make for abundant ammunition. Even better, some are poisonous.

effects.description: Increases the effect of Trixie's Specializations by $amount%

display.name: 荆棘之弓
display.description: 荆棘本身就是取之不尽的弹药， 更妙的是，有些还带毒。

effects.description: 使特里克茜的专精效果提高 $amount%

original.name: Weft
original.description: It never runs out of spider silk, which is more useful than you think.

effects.description: Increases the effect of Trixie's Specializations by $amount%

display.name: 纬纱
display.description: 它的蜘蛛丝永远用不完，那玩意的用处可比你想的多得多。

effects.description: 使特里克茜的专精效果提高 $amount%

original.name: Regretful Hairpiece
original.description: So tacky. I hate this. Can't believe I ever wore it.

display.name: 令人后悔的假发
display.description: 太俗气了。 我超讨厌。 真不敢相信我居然戴过。

original.name: Fickle Fashion
original.description: On second thought, it might be just what I'm feeling today!

display.name: 多变的时尚
display.description: 转念一想，这说不定正合我今天的心情！

original.name: Wig of Whimsy
original.description: This one changes both color and style at random. It's so much fun.

display.name: 奇思假发
display.description: 它的颜色和造型会随机变化。 太有趣了。

original.name: Perfect Postiche
original.description: I'm in my 'Archfey' era.

display.name: 完美假发
display.description: 姐现在正处于“大妖精”时期。
